name: SweetSpecter
brief: OpenAI disrupted a cluster of accounts attributed to SweetSpecter, a suspected China-based actor. The group conducted unsuccessful spear-phishing against OpenAI's own employees (a malicious "some problems.zip" attachment delivering the SugarGh0st RAT, identified in collaboration with Proofpoint), and separately used ChatGPT for reconnaissance and vulnerability research — checking Log4Shell-vulnerable versions, seeking sqlmap web-shell-upload guidance, looking up CVEs, asking about building internet-wide scanners, debugging an SMS-spam framework, and requesting phishing-lure "theme" and attachment-naming suggestions. *Backfill note: see CyberAv3ngers row above — same October 2024 report, misdated by a secondary source as "September 2026."* OpenAI
